story.title: Phenotype, precisely read.
story.lede: Phenograph identifies morphological features from a single facial image and ranks candidate syndromes against the HPO ontology.
story.act2Title: From a strand of code to a face in reference.
story.act2Body: Sub-millimeter landmarks are localized against a curated atlas of 127 morphological features, then triangulated into a reference mesh for metric analysis.
story.meshDisclaimer: All imagery shown is an abstract reference mesh. Phenograph never exposes identifiable patient faces.
story.disclaimerShort: Not a diagnostic device. Clinical decision support only.

features.heading: A quiet tool that extends clinical expertise — not a replacement for it.

landmark.title: Landmark phenotyping
landmark.body: Sub-millimeter facial landmarking against a curated atlas of 127 morphological features, scored with uncertainty.

ranking.title: Syndrome ranking
ranking.body: Bayesian ranking across 4,300+ syndromes linked to the Human Phenotype Ontology. Clinicians see posterior probabilities, not black-box scores.

workflow.title: Clinical workflow
workflow.body: Case notes, features, and candidate panels export to FHIR. Integrates with existing EHRs without forcing a rebuild.

evidence.heading: Validated against 12,000+ genetically confirmed cases across 41 institutions.
evidence.accuracy: Top-5 accuracy on blind validation set of rare syndrome cases.
evidence.syndromes: Syndromes covered in the linked knowledge graph. HPO-aligned.
evidence.publications: Peer-reviewed publications. Nature Genetics, AJHG, JAMA Pediatrics.
